data.summary_en: ARIA, a meta-controller, models consultation as sequential resource allocation, maps execution evidence to compact state, and learns action-values from cost-penalized outcomes via Monte Carlo control for SILENT/CONSULT; on SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.1, and $\tau^2$-bench, it recovers 44-81% of executor-advisor success gap below half advisor-model cost.
